newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 25.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 25.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Wednesday, despite storms throughout the country, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

A tropical depression off the coast expected to turn into a storm later in the day, dropping rain along states of Colima, Sinaloa, Nayarit, Jalisco and Michoacan. The depression was located about 140 miles (224 km) from the coast and moving northwest.
Clear skies and hot temperatures along the remainder of the coastline with maximum winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high.
Light to medium rains along coasts of Tamaulipas, Veracruz and Tabasco states. Maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour).
Hot and partly cloudy with regional winds about 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
Possible light rains later in the day along Quintana Roo and Belize.
